text: Skyscraper-sized twisted crystals: transparent with refraction (by day and/or night)
description: A forest that mixes organic and constructional forms, solarpunk, 3D noisy and twisting. Analytic SDF: a twist domain warp plus noise warp on elongated hexagonal prisms; raymarching makes refraction cheap.

status.comment: Fader `crystals` (city tab, 0..1, default 0) = fraction of cells drawn as twisted hexagonal prisms in scene.vert (6 sides x 6 rings, per-cell twist up to +-3 rad, taper 0.65, tip over the top 20%, flat facets; 234 vertices per instance). Collision/raycast keep the cell's box. Verified: compiles; geometry plotted offline; seen in the app (Monado simulated headset, nice-net, crystals = 1, EYE_SIZE 256, SNAPSHOT): coloured twisted faceted crystals with tips under the net, scene pass 0.72 ms for both eyes. They read stubby at the defaults (cell 4 m, height 7 m): footprint nearly the cell width. Open for Felix: slimmer/taller (radius factor, extra height; taller than the block would need city.rs collision to follow), replace or mix with blocks, night windows on crystals? Refraction not started.
